fields.access_token: string UI JWT (pairing mode, relay mode)

payload.pairing_code: string required for relay; optional on local transport
payload.client_pub: string base64url X25519 public key; required for relay pairing and optional for local pairing
payload.client_public_key: string compatibility alias accepted for client_pub

constraints: relay pairing rejects requests without a client X25519 public key
local pairing may omit client_pub and use a direct plaintext pairing_result on the originating local socket; unauthenticated pairing-first access is loopback-only

payload.client_id: string present directly for local pairing; encrypted inside relay payload.e2e.ciphertext
payload.access_token: string UI JWT present directly for local pairing; encrypted inside relay payload.e2e.ciphertext
payload.token_type: string (Bearer) present directly for local pairing; encrypted for relay pairing
payload.expires_in: integer seconds present directly for local pairing; encrypted for relay pairing
payload.set_cookie: string cookie value present directly for local pairing; encrypted for relay pairing
payload.e2e_required: boolean present directly for local pairing; encrypted for relay pairing and controls subsequent message payloads only

e2e.agent_pub: string required for relay, base64url X25519 public key
e2e.nonce: string required for relay, base64url nonce
e2e.ciphertext: string required for relay, base64url ciphertext and authentication tag; decrypted JSON contains client_id, access_token, token_type, expires_in, set_cookie, and e2e_required

constraints: relay plaintext payload contains ok plus e2e only; bearer credentials and cookie are never exposed outside ciphertext
the relay credential wrapper is mandatory even when relay_e2e_required is false
local pairing may return credentials directly to the originating local socket

payload.content: string required unless payload.e2e is used
payload.access_token: string required in pairing mode (can be top-level access_token)
payload.auth_token: string required in local token mode (can be top-level auth_token)

e2e.nonce: string required when e2e is used (base64url)
e2e.ciphertext: string required when e2e is used (base64url)

payload.content: string required unless payload.e2e is used

e2e.nonce: string required when e2e is used (base64url)
e2e.ciphertext: string required when e2e is used (base64url)

payload.content: string required unless payload.e2e is used

e2e.nonce: string required when e2e is used (base64url)
e2e.ciphertext: string required when e2e is used (base64url)

envelope.request_id: string required opaque server-generated one-shot id

constraints: authenticated plaintext control; local transport only in v1 because relay lacks owner-addressed delivery acknowledgement; local loopback permits it with message E2E while public/LAN local binds do not
request_id expires after 300 seconds and can be consumed once

envelope.request_id: string required; must echo the approval_request id

payload.access_token: string required in pairing mode (can be top-level access_token)
payload.auth_token: string required in local token mode (can be top-level auth_token)

constraints: plaintext only; encrypted decisions are rejected
session and authenticated principal must match the original request
expired, mismatched, and replayed ids are rejected

pairing_code.description: One-time code printed by nullclaw relay connection

ui_access_token.description: JWT used by browser UI for relay user_message

relay_agent_token.description: Dedicated relay credential for nullclaw <-> relay transport auth
relay_agent_token.lifecycle: config relay_token -> env NULLCLAW_RELAY_TOKEN -> persisted auth credential -> generated token

relay_pairing_credential_envelope.description: X25519 + ChaCha20-Poly1305 wrapper for client_id, access_token, and cookie returned by relay pairing
relay_pairing_credential_envelope.confidentiality: protects pairing credentials in transit from passive observation on the relay path
relay_pairing_credential_envelope.trust_boundary: relay transport remains trusted for integrity and key delivery because client_pub travels in the pairing request
relay_pairing_credential_envelope.limitation: not an authenticated PAKE and does not protect against active key substitution by the relay

local_message_token.description: Local user_message token auth for orchestration mode

approval_capability.description: Server-generated request_id bound to session and authenticated principal
approval_capability.lifecycle: single use; fail closed on expiry, mismatch, replay, unavailable delivery, relay transport, or unsupported public-bind E2E context
